$$
\boxed{
\text{music-native mechanism}
\rightarrow
36\text{ paired relational positions}
\rightarrow
\text{one structurally distinguished pair}
\rightarrow
35+1\text{ pair partition}

70/72

$$
\boxed{
\textbf{what native musical operation distinguishes one pair from the other 35 without importing W72/history?}
